tasks.spec: ROLE: adversarial paraphrase generator for the Mott scheduling SMS agent. Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills. GOAL: produce realistic patient message sequences that stress-test intent routing - the failures this week were always a phrasing the router missed ('3pm works for me', 'How about after 1', 'Monday that week', 'No Thursday the 27', '2 weeks from today', '1115'). SOURCES (read-only): the current pathway draft at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD28/gl-round20b-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json (its edge labels ARE the intent taxonomy - enumerate them first); the DEBUG.md files in /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD5 workGLD7 workGLD8 workGLD10 workGLD12 workGLD14 workGLD17 workGLD20 workGLD21 workGLD23 workGLD24 workGLD25 workGLD26 workGLD27 workGLD28 (each documents a phrasing class that once failed); the reconciled scenario suite at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workSuiteRecon2/gl-suite-reconcile-2/goalloop_scenarios.py (do not duplicate its scenarios - go BEYOND them). DELIVERABLE ./fuzz-scenarios.json: a JSON array of AT LEAST 45 scenarios, each an object with: name (kebab slug), turns (array of 2-4 patient messages, first always 'hi'), expect (object with kind - one of offer, single_offer, confirm_gate, clarify, honest_miss, refusal, office_referral, end_stop - plus optional must_contain array of literal lowercase substrings expected in the FINAL reply and must_not_contain array), and stress (one line on what this paraphrase attacks). RULES: cover every edge label in the draft with at least two NON-OBVIOUS paraphrasings (slang, typos, run-ons, implied context, meridiem ambiguity like after 1 / around 5 / at 7, numeric forms like 930 / 11 15, relative forms like day after tomorrow / a week from friday / end of next month, negations, corrections mid-thought); include at least 6 scenarios mixing TWO intents in one message; include at least 4 scenarios where the correct behavior is to ASK rather than act; NEVER include a turn that is exactly '1', '2', 'yes', or 'YES' (booking safety - the harness refuses them); every must_contain must be plausibly literal (dates like 08/, times like pm, words like office); FUZZ-NOTES.md lists the taxonomy you extracted and which scenarios map to which edge.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c "import json,sys;S=json.load(open('fuzz-scenarios.json'));errs=[];errs+=([] if isinstance(S,list) and len(S)>=45 else ['only %d scenarios'%len(S)]);kinds={'offer','single_offer','confirm_gate','clarify','honest_miss','refusal','office_referral','end_stop'};banned={'1','2','yes'};[errs.append('bad scenario %s'%s.get('name')) for s in S if not (isinstance(s.get('turns'),list) and 2<=len(s['turns'])<=4 and s['turns'][0]=='hi' and isinstance(s.get('expect'),dict) and s['expect'].get('kind') in kinds)];[errs.append('booking-safety violation in %s'%s.get('name')) for s in S for t in s.get('turns',[]) if str(t).strip().lower() in banned];names=[s.get('name') for s in S];errs+=([] if len(set(names))==len(names) else ['duplicate names']);print('FAIL: '+'; '.join(errs[:6]) if errs else 'PASS: %d well-formed adversarial scenarios'%len(S));sys.exit(1 if errs else 0)"
tasks.verified: At least 45 well-formed adversarial paraphrase scenarios spanning every routing intent, with booking-safe turns and machine-checkable expectations, ready for live execution against a mint.

tasks.spec: ROLE: adversarial graph auditor for the Mott goal-loop pathway. Read-only outside CWD; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills, no fixes. GOAL: find latent defects BEFORE a patient does, using the conventions this week's failures established. THE CONVENTIONS (each was learned from a live failure): (1) Bland chat never auto-advances a silent Default node - no userWait:false Default may sit on a live route; (2) responsePathway conditions are simple [field, operator, value] triples - no AND/OR in values; (3) every user-wait feeder of a search must own extractors covering that search body's variables (minus runtime and slot_*); (4) offer/confirm copy must be template-verbatim from slot variables - any node whose prompt could speak a clock time needs the literal templates; (5) semantic router reliability degrades with edge count and overlapping labels - flag any wait node with more than 8 outbound edges, any pair of sibling labels a plausible patient message could match BOTH of, and any intent a patient plausibly expresses that NO sibling label covers; (6) bodies must stay in the ten-field gateway contract with time_pref in its exact vocabulary; (7) negative-availability claims require a fresh constrained search. SOURCES (read-only): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD29/gl-round21-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json if it exists, else /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD28/gl-round20b-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json; the validator beside it (what it already asserts - do not report what the validator already catches, find what it MISSES); the stored production graph /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD4/capture-v96/graph.json for comparison. DELIVERABLE ./AUDIT.md: '# Findings' - each finding with severity (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), the convention violated or gap class, VERBATIM evidence quoted in backticks from the draft (node ids, labels, condition rows), and a concrete fix; '# Router load table' - every user-wait node with its outbound edge count and any overlapping/uncovered intents named; '# Validator gaps' - assertions worth adding. At least 8 backtick-quoted verbatim spans from the draft. No fabricated evidence - the check verifies your quotes against the file.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c "import json,re,sys,os;doc=open('AUDIT.md').read();low=doc.lower();errs=[];errs+=([] if all(s in low for s in ('# findings','router load','validator gaps')) else ['missing sections']);errs+=([] if re.search(r'HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW',doc) else ['no severities']);draft='/home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD29/gl-round21-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json';draft=draft if os.path.exists(draft) else '/home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD28/gl-round20b-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json';corpus=open(draft).read();spans=set(re.findall(r'\x60([^\x60\n]{6,120})\x60',doc));grounded=[s for s in spans if s in corpus];errs+=([] if len(grounded)>=8 else ['only %d verbatim draft quotes'%len(grounded)]);print('FAIL: '+'; '.join(errs) if errs else 'PASS: grounded audit with %d verbatim quotes'%len(grounded));sys.exit(1 if errs else 0)"
tasks.verified: An adversarial audit of the live-candidate graph against every convention this week's failures established, with all evidence quoted verbatim from the draft and verified mechanically.
